title: Initial step selects the coin branch
statement: Let $N_0,N_1$ be finite nondeterministic Turing machines with Boolean symbols, let $x$ be a Boolean input, and let $b\in\{0,1\}$. Taking one step of the combined machine from its initial configuration on $x$ using choice $b$ gives the embedded initial configuration of $N_1$ when $b=1$, and the embedded initial configuration of $N_0$ when $b=0$.
hypotheses_covered: $N_0,N_1$ are finite nondeterministic Turing machines with Boolean symbols
